heading:
Five service lines,
one trusted name

items.title: Hardware Sales & AMC
items.description: Branded desktops, laptops, peripherals, and long-term on-site Annual Maintenance Contracts for government offices and enterprise clients across the district.

items.title: Data Entry & Digitization
items.description: Large-scale census, identity, agricultural, and rural banking records digitization — from physical documents to structured, searchable digital archives.

items.title: IT Manpower Outsourcing
items.description: Deployment of trained data entry operators, hardware technicians, and project staff on temporary and contract basis for government and institutional projects.

items.title: Custom Software Development
items.description: Domain-specific solutions for retail, pharma distributors, and hospital management — including the full clinical system deployed at Pioneer Hospital.

items.title: Hardware & Software Training
items.description: Comprehensive curriculum covering computer hardware assembly, troubleshooting, office automation, and programming — producing work-ready technicians since 1994.
